description: S46 T5's mcp.server.add — the human adds a server. Success shape: the updated MCPServerView rides with the before/after grants for every affected agent and changed:true. Adding a PUBLIC server grants nothing (MC5): the grants list is empty because nobody's view moved. Env entries are NAMES (MG13 — the type has nowhere to put a value); an unclassified tool earns the fixed MC6 warning. Params never carry actor/origin/id/timestamps — the identity keys are a shape error. Every env name is bound to a stored variable (envFrom: process name -> variable name) or given a typed value (envValues, write-only: it is kept in the variable manager as a hidden secret and only the binding is stored); an environment variable cannot be empty.
